title: Ladoo Heist
hook: Tiptoe past a sleeping bear and sneak every ladoo out of Grandma's kitchen.

theme.keyArtPrompt: A huge sleeping brown bear snoring in a cozy grandma's kitchen, plates of golden ladoos on every counter, warm lamplight, no text

sprites.player: tiny sneaky kid in socks, top-down cartoon
sprites.ladoo: golden round ladoo sweet, top-down cartoon
sprites.bear: sleeping brown bear in an apron, top-down cartoon

timeline.hostLine: The guard is sleepwalking! Everyone, freeze!

host.intro: The guard is snoring and the treats are out. Sneak in and grab them all.
host.finale: The guard wakes up to an empty room. Who is the sneakiest of them all?
host.tutorial: Move with the stick. Hold Tiptoe near the guard to stay silent. Touch a treat to grab it.
